notes.title: Version 1.4.1 is released! Custom controls and slow motion timer
notes.content:
[h1]Version 1.4.1[/h1]

[h1]1. Customs controls [/h1]
You are enabled to configure keyboard and joystick controls now. Configure it in a way it best suit your preferences. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32282000/4e61d8ebabd5ffe5ef14a8d0e365666bc89634a2.png[/img]


[h1]2. Slow motion timer[/h1]
Slow motion is a cool feature that allows to be more precise in note picking and   help to receive bonuses during the game session. Now using the timer on the screen, you can control the slow motion time and use it more efficiently. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32282000/871663d2f7b58dd88f242778b382a6742281a10d.png[/img]


[h1]3. New tracks in Workshop[/h1]
New 5 tracks are added to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/818620/workshop/]Workshop[/url]. Visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/818620/workshop/]Workshop page[/url] and download it from there.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32282000/facde82ff8371e8b74b3501105e4d73917c45fc7.png[/img]

[h1]4. Bug fixes and small improvements[/h1]
Camera bug fixed
Tracks library loading bar added 
City audio bug fixed
Slow motion time limit extended
Start game UI bug fixed

notes.title: Version 1.4 is released! New game modes and improvements
notes.content:
Version 1.4

1. Side mode
In this mode, the camera is located on the right, the player can not move left or right. It looks like a 2D game. It can remind you of Beat.Trip Runner game.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32282000/98fc31fef367d0a058a27dba966703cc65c41ba8.png[/img]

2. Mixed mode
This mode combines all the modes. During one song, the mode will change in the most appropriate way. For example, the side view is suitable for places with many notes. The front view can make the game more exciting where there is little music.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32282000/888634a2ad808cace3527f3b4bac410d0146568b.png[/img]

3. Gameplay improvements and bugfixes

3.1 Now the hero starts to burn when the multiplication of points begins five times. It looks beautiful visually and makes it clear to the player that he is gaining maximum points.

3.2 The game does not end at the slightest collision with an obstacle. The hero just stumbles and will continue to run. This makes the game more balanced and more interesting.

3.3 Small improvements and bugfixes

notes.title: Version 1.3 is released! It brings Workshop, Leaderboards and Achievements support
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce the new version of Music Boy 3D.

Version 1.3

1.  Workshop 
Now you are allowed to publish and download custom tracks from Steam Workshop. Tracks can be easily found by music genre tag in the Workshop catalog. Also,  each track contains music author name, title, and cover image.

See the guide pages to know how to publish and download tracks from Steam Workshop.

2. Leaderboards 
Each track, even published in Workshop, has its own leaderboard. Finish the track, and see how good you are.

3. Achievements
At the moment, your achievements can be the completion of the track and publication of the track. Finish more tracks to get a higher achievement.
